title: pseudostellaria heterantha var. himalaica
intro: Pseudostellaria heterantha var. himalaica, commonly known as Himalayan false starwort or Chinese false starwort, is a perennial plant native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating respiratory issues, fever, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Pseudostellaria heterantha var. himalaica include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
